Together Link connects the coding agents to open models on Together AI through a one-command setup. [...] Key features:

• Works with Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, ChatGPT Desktop, OpenCode, and Pi  
• Choose individual open models or use Auto Router to route tasks automatically  
• Access models including Kimi K3, GLM 5.3, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, and MiniMax M3  
• Keep your existing agent settings and switch back to your normal setup anytime  
• Get a cost receipt for each proxied session  
• Track usage and spending across sessions  
• Use Together AI's per-token pricing for model usage  
• Install with a single command without manually editing your agent configuration

Together Link is built for developers and engineering teams that want to use open models without changing the coding tools they already work with.

Try Together Link [...] What makes it different: You keep your existing agent, login, settings, history, and workflow while Together Link routes sessions to open models and shows what each session costs.

Together Link is free and open source, model usage is billed through Together AI.
